published_prior_art.cite: kivva2022revisiting: positive gID is reduced to fixed-graph ID subproblems; the proposed star specialization and explicit binary witness are not stated there.
bachtler2024almost proves Sigma_2^P-completeness for forbidden arc-pair separation on acyclic graphs, not the revealed-completion causal-source and proxy-vertex design language.
lee2020general supplies fixed-graph gID formulas and failure objects; this is a star-specific interface consequence.
Standard vertex-cut/max-flow theory supplies the computational conclusion once the proposed star criterion is established.
The monotonicity collapse is a direct consequence of edge-set inclusion plus the proposed separation criterion.
No located result resolves robust switched causal-star design under completion-wise bounded terminal degree.

soundness_flags.label: thm:robust-design-complexity / def:robust-design-language
soundness_flags.one_line: The input encoding of the succinct family (explicit representation of E^fix, E^cup, lambda, R, and B) is not specified, so the asserted Sigma_2^P language and its membership claim are not formally defined.

soundness_flags.label: ass:completion-revealed
soundness_flags.one_line: The load-bearing claim that an audit reveals latent-confounding completion bits after acquisition is not operationally justified; an ADMG bidirected edge is ordinarily latent, so the stated audit mechanism needs a concrete observable metadata protocol.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 4, Theorem 1; p. 1, Definition-5 discussion of positivity
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For a single c-component, g-identifiability holds iff an available source containing that component identifies it in the induced fixed graph; the paper makes observational positivity part of gID.
Minimum-cost intervention design on a known graph is NP-complete and is formulated through hedge hitting.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 5, Theorem 1 and weighted partial MAX-SAT reformulation
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: A 3-SAT construction characterizes feasible hedge-hitting intervention sets and yields a weighted partial MAX-SAT formulation for fixed-graph proxy design.
The paper studies gID from arbitrary observational and experimental distributions, gives hedgelet/thicket nonidentification machinery, and states a sound and complete procedure.
The paper optimizes the most plausible identifiable subgraph under probabilistic edge uncertainty and calls the resulting edge-ID optimization NP-complete.
SFP selects arc pairs so every s-t path contains both arcs of a selected pair and is Sigma_2^P-complete even on acyclic graphs.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define the exact bit-level input format for RSJID and state the polynomial verifier for a fixed completion before retaining the Sigma_2^P membership and completeness claim.

Replace the graph-audit story with a concrete setting in which switch bits are recorded design or administrative metadata, or explicitly make the result conditional on an oracle completion label and narrow the applied consumer accordingly.
Promote the bounded-terminal-degree question by proving either a bounded-degree hardness construction or an FPT boundary-signature algorithm with parameter d.

recommended_next_step: Revise the language encoding and completion-revelation protocol, then advance the field-tier robust-design kernel to Stage 0.
